rationale: Alex's conviction that ML dev tooling needs unification pairs naturally with Ariadne's work on domain-aware AI agents and context engineering at Avenir AI — both are solving fragmentation problems in AI infrastructure, just at different layers. Ariadne's experience building AI safety guardrails and hallucination mitigation at Microsoft and her healthcare ML research background could inform the reliability and safety considerations Alex values in cutting-edge tooling, while Alex's deep work in ML infrastructure and developer tools could accelerate Avenir's agent reliability at scale.
intro_message: Alex Kreidler, meet Ariadne Dulchinos — you're both tackling fragmentation in AI systems (tooling vs. domain agents) and share a focus on infrastructure reliability; Ariadne's AI safety expertise and domain ontology work could complement your vision for unified ML dev tooling.
